Delphi den Riet <Delphi.denRiet@mst.nl>:
Good morning, Two months ago, we began our Virtual Trial study using Avicenna at MST Hospital in Enschede. However, we inadvertently exported the incorrect data for August and September. Could you please advise on how we can download the questionnaire responses? Additionally, is there a way to receive the data for September? Met vriendelijke groet,​​​​ ​ Delphi den Riet Researcher ​Spreekuurpoli Reumatologie poli 63 ​ ​www.mst.nl------

Amin Ghaffari <support@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi DelphiGlad to hear that you've been using Avicenna for the past two months,Sure. You can always refer to View Responses | Avicenna Learn (avicennaresearch.com) for more info, but in short:1- From the side bar on the left click on "Activity Responses" (Third item from bottom)2- Select the questionnaire (we call them Survey in our terminology) that you're looking for from the activity drop down 3- Click on "Export as CSV"4- Download the file and view all the answers regardless of the date/time. If you want all the answers to all the activities, alternatively you can click on "Export All Activities Responses As CSV" Please let me know if it worked or not. Best regards,Amin Note: If you feel like your issue is not properly being addressed and want to escalate it, please click here: https://avicennaresearch.com/app/public/zammad/escalate/25651/501fc66afb06cd8f --Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: support@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com-- On Wednesday, October 9, 2024 at 11:49:39 AM,

Mohammad Hashemian:
Amin Ghaffari Recovering deleted data takes around 1 day. We do not spend that much time unless it's very necessary.This study is using a Trial version. And their approach is "download the data right before it gets deleted". They could have just reached out and ask for a pro-bono license. We cannot recover it right now, but we can set their license to a free license.------

Amin Ghaffari:
Mohammad Hashemian How about we push the needle a bit and ask for a price to recover the data? Does that sit with our policy?------

Mohammad Hashemian:
If they had money, they would buy a license. Asking for payment shows "we can do it, we just don't want to unless you pay!". Makes it worse.------

Amin Ghaffari:
I see. You're correct Mohammad Hashemian. Will let them know about the free license though.------

Amin Ghaffari <support@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi DelphiI did check with the team and unfortunately your data is gone and I'm sorry to inform you that we cannot do anything for that at the moment.
